verdict.line: You don't lose lane by default at 46.3% over 246 games, but every unforced error around her Riposte timing or Lunge chains is what tips it her way.

brief.thesis: Fiora wins short pokey trades because her Q (Lunge) dash and E (Burst of Speed) attack speed let her hit and reset range before your slower Q swings land, but once your R (World Ender) is up at level 6 the sustain, AD, and Move Speed it grants flip extended fights and all-ins toward you. This is a lane about picking your trade length, not your trade frequency.

theirWindow.when: Her E (Burst of Speed) active and Q up
theirWindow.what: She's chaining Lunge into attack-speed autos that each refresh her Move Speed boost, letting her stick to you or disengage at will — don't try to out-trade her inside this window, just eat the poke and reset.

yourWindow.when: Deathbringer Stance charged and W off cooldown
yourWindow.what: Land W (Infernal Chains) first so she either eats double damage standing still or has to run out of the zone, then walk in and weave your empowered auto — this is your highest-value trade shape all lane.

start.why: Measured at 52.5% win rate over 139 games — the regen and damage reduction blunt her Duelist passive stacking in the early poke exchanges before your R comes online.

boots.why: 86.9% pick rate and the highest measured win rate (50.6% over 245 games) — she wants to land repeated Q (Lunge) hits and autos during E (Burst of Speed), and Steelcaps flattens that basic-attack damage.

core.why: Highest-win-rate opening in the data (55.6% over 9 games) — the shield proc covers you through her Lunge-into-autos trade pattern.
Follows Eclipse in the same measured path; the on-hit proc and shield reward landing your Q swings during your R window.
Closes out the 55.6% win rate path and directly answers her Duelist passive sustain by cutting the healing she stacks off you.

situational.when: she's out-healing your trades off Duelist stacks before you've finished Death's Dance
you need anti-heal online earlier than your third item completes
you're ahead and want faster Q and W cooldowns to snowball instead of the Eclipse burst path

runes.keystoneWhy: Run on the highest-sample page (51.9% win rate, 43.3% pick) — the stacking AD/heal amp rewards the exact extended-trade, all-in style your R enables from level 6 on.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is the majority pick (69.1%) and adds kill pressure to your post-6 all-in windows; Flash+Teleport (48.2% win rate, 27.9% pick) is the alternative if you expect the lane to go long and need side-lane flexibility instead.

playing.title: Respect her Riposte timer
playing.detail: Track her W (Riposte) cooldown — 10/9/8/7/6s. If it's up, hold your empowered Deathbringer Stance auto rather than walking it into range, since a parried auto reflects magic damage back at you.

playing.title: Land W before you commit
playing.detail: Open trades with your W (Infernal Chains) at 825 range so she either eats it twice trying to run out of the impact zone or takes the first hit standing still, instead of letting her Q (Lunge) open on you first.

playing.title: Don't fish Q into her W
playing.detail: Throwing out Q swings when Riposte is available risks eating the parry. Bait it with a normal auto or an E (Umbral Dash) step-in first, then commit your Q.

playing.title: Trade hard from level 6
playing.detail: Your R (World Ender) fears nearby minions and grants bonus AD, increased healing, and Move Speed for its duration — once it's up, this is where the 46.3% deficit gets clawed back, so look to force fights here.

playing.title: Deny her E resets
playing.detail: Her E (Burst of Speed) only keeps extending its Move Speed bonus while her attacks or Lunges land — use E (Umbral Dash) to step out of range right after she lands a hit so she can't chain into a run-down.

playing.title: Watch the anti-heal timing
playing.detail: Her Duelist passive stacks sustain every time she damages you. If she's clearly out-healing your trades before Death's Dance is done, pick up Executioner's Calling or Bramble Vest early instead of waiting.

playing.title: Track your own passive
playing.detail: Deathbringer Stance periodically empowers your next auto with bonus magic damage and a heal based on her max health — always know when it's up and force it into your trade windows, not just when it happens to proc.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and every win-rate/sample number above are pulled from measured OP.GG games on the current patch (16.19.1); the trade patterns, cooldown reads, and lane-plan reasoning are my own tactical judgement on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid being hit with Fiora’s Riposte (W) while you are executing [Q] by moving away with [E]. Use your abilities whenever they come off cooldown while considering her Riposte (W).
